primary_source.finding: The spatial-relationships entry directly pairs Bitłʼááh with Bottom. Author and reviewer separately viewed the source; reviewer independently rendered the page. Crossed ł and both acute accents verified; apostrophe normalized to U+02BC. No manufactured morphology.

independent_review.scope: Independent remote fetches of relevant resource and caller blobs matched the clean local reviewed tree. The single exact production ui_bottom use was found in that local tree; no fresh complete remote tree audit claimed.

callers.finding: Only production exact ui_bottom reference in complete local tree is linkedMapOf bottom in numeric trim dialog. Fourth value is bottom trim amount; displayed amount is source height minus crop rect bottom. Label appears in TextView and is passed as %1$s into content descriptions.
CropMargins bottom produces size.height-amount(bottom,size.height), confirming margin removed at lower edge, not alignment.
Distinct ui_bottom23 means Bottom aligned in vertical text alignment; excluded.

independent_review.guards: Candidate exact SHA confirmed; NFC and XML round trip passed; current Navajo key absent; source name attributes match; no placeholders introduced. Other resource catalogues are independent and untouched.

guidance_dependency: No existing literal guidance reference to this trim caption requires replacement. Ordinary spatial bottom references and distinct ui_bottom23 text-alignment resource are outside this change.
